body:
Follow-up from #454. This issue is deliberately blocked until #454 is merged and its evidence packet is available on main.

## Exact scope

Review exactly 15 Fiji location IDs in the attached scope JSON. Resolve the 2007 census / 2020 registry-vintage conflict and the retained-release versus registry byte SHA mismatch; reproduce the Lau source/Atlas footprint divergence (Jaccard 0.769; symmetric difference 120.36 km²); and provide an authoritative semantic handoff for Rotuma, which Fiji's Prime Minister office describes as a dependency under the Rotuma Act while census reporting groups it with provinces. Do not make core geography edits or infer which geometry is correct from resemblance alone.

Acceptance: exact source chain and licenses; every subject classified individually; source hash/retrieval/restoration details; defensible comparison or explicit unavailable evidence; explicit Rotuma engineering handoff; positive/negative scoped reproduction; evidence-quality manifest; independent exact-head review; one focused PR through the serialized merge queue. No region approval or publication.

Reference evidence from parent #454: retained census-derived layer SHA-256 a9cd94789cb5eb66cfbcbaf32a21bcbceba16b9a76adacba9ac675b950ca1ccd; registry source SHA-256 0339f90794264719b98c93a9a7c2d71fdb473c0a2f9c1e9b74ecd98a67ddb93f; source vintage/title discrepancy; official 2017 census roster; Rotuma official semantic source; exact unit findings are in #454's linked packet. Upstream restoration URL: https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09/releaseData/gbOpen/FJI/ADM2/geoBoundaries-FJI-ADM2.geojson .
